name: Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Warwick
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Warwick, and how long you've been running the academy.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before we started working together, what did your online presence look like — and what was that costing you in new students?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: When you decided to get serious about showing up on Google, why trust Sammy and Panicci Ventures with it?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures actually take off your plate day to day — the website, Google Business Profile, reviews, content?

questions.label: The Numbers
questions.text: Real numbers: in the last 12 months your site showed up in Google searches over 35,000 times — from a standing start the year before. Where do you feel that inside the gym?

questions.label: Rankings
questions.text: You're #1 on Google when someone near Warwick searches “BJJ near me” — and #1 for “jiu-jitsu Warwick RI.” When did you first notice new students saying they found you on Google?

questions.label: Reviews
questions.text: Your profile shows 111 Google reviews, a 4.96 average, and every single one has a reply. How much of that do you have to think about yourself?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other agencies or marketers you've dealt with — communication, speed, no lock-in contracts?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another gym or academy owner whose business is invisible on Google right now?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Warwick. Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. The NUMBERS, RANKINGS, and REVIEWS answers are the hero clips (real stats + reaction); RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
